authorized_evidence.content:
Release Windows

Standard production deployments occur Tuesday through Thursday between 10:00 and 15:00 Eastern Time. Deployments outside that window require approval from the Engineering Manager on call and a written reason in the change record.

Friday deployments are limited to severity-one fixes, security patches approved by IT Admin, or customer-impacting incidents where waiting would increase risk. Weekend deployments require the incident commander to approve the change before execution.

Deployment Approval

| Change Type | Required Review | Required Approver |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Documentation-only release | Peer review | Team lead |
| Low-risk application change | Peer review and automated tests | Team lead |
| Database migration | Peer review, rollback plan, staging proof | Engineering Manager |
| Security-sensitive change | Peer review, IT Admin review | Engineering Manager |
| Emergency hotfix | Incident commander review | Engineering Manager on call |

All production changes must include a rollback plan. A rollback plan that says "revert if needed" is not sufficient; it must name the specific revert, migration rollback, feature flag, or mitigation.

Working Hours

Standard collaboration hours are 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. local time from Monday to Thursday. Teams may define additional overlap windows when customer coverage or release coordination requires it.

Employees should keep calendars accurate and mark focus time when unavailable. Repeated inability to meet team collaboration expectations should be discussed with the employee's manager.

Privileged Access Review

Privileged access must be reviewed monthly for production systems and quarterly for business applications. Reviewers must confirm business need, manager approval, and least-privilege alignment.

Privileged access exceptions require an owner, expiration date, and documented business justification.

Change Freeze

Northstar observes deployment freezes during payroll close, quarter-end financial reporting, and announced customer migration windows. The change calendar is the source of truth. Older release notes or team chat messages do not override the current freeze calendar.

On-Call Severity Levels

| Severity | Definition | Initial Response Target |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| SEV-1 | Widespread production outage or data exposure risk | 15 minutes |
| SEV-2 | Major workflow unavailable for multiple customers | 30 minutes |
| SEV-3 | Degraded feature with workaround available | 4 business hours |
| SEV-4 | Low-impact defect or documentation issue | Next planning cycle |

The on-call engineer owns triage until an incident commander is assigned. The incident commander owns status updates, escalation, and post-incident review scheduling.

Office Expectations

Hybrid teams should define collaboration days at least one month in advance. Employees should attend required team planning, onboarding, incident review, and customer workshop sessions in person when asked by their manager.

Vacation Approval Workflow

Vacation requests of 1 to 5 business days should be submitted at least 10 business days in advance. Requests longer than 5 business days should be submitted at least 20 business days in advance.

Managers approve vacation based on business coverage, project deadlines, and fairness across the team. Managers should not deny vacation without explaining the business reason.

Approval Requirements

Employees must receive manager approval before changing their regular work location. A temporary change within the same country for fewer than 15 business days may be approved by the manager. Longer changes require People Operations review.

Managers should consider team coverage, customer needs, time zone overlap, and data handling requirements before approving remote work.

Contract Approval Process

| Contract Type | Legal Review | Finance Review | Final Approver |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard customer order form under USD 25,000 ARR | Optional unless redlines exist | Deal Desk | Sales Manager |
| Customer contract with security addendum | Required | Deal Desk | Sales Director |
| Vendor agreement under USD 10,000 | Required if data processing applies | Finance | Department Manager |
| Vendor agreement USD 10,000 or above | Required | Finance | Department Leader |
| Employment-related agreement | Required | HR Admin | People Leader |

No employee may sign a contract on behalf of Northstar unless they are listed in the signature authority register maintained by Legal Operations.
